name: PGSA990_Otto_Lilienthal
description: A hypothetical variation of a heavy German aircraft carrier based on the unfinished H-39 class battleship hull. It is assumed that by the time the construction of the battleship was halted, her hull would have been fully shaped, and the main propulsion plant and electrical plant machinery would also have been installed. With such a configuration, she would have been one of the largest ships in the world, second only to Japanese Shinano.

consumables.name: Damage Control Party
consumables.description:
Extinguishes fires, removes instances of flooding, and repairs damaged modules.
Prevents enemy submarine-launched torpedoes from homing.

consumables.name: Interceptors
consumables.description:
Follow the ship and automatically attack enemy aircraft.

Can attack Airstrike squadrons multiple times before returning to the ship.

Invulnerable against hostile fighters, do not attack them, and cannot spot enemy ships.
